title: Vanessa found the teller tape for the documentary

tellings.quote: We wouldn't have found the teller tape if it wasn't for Vanessa.

plain: A key piece of evidence for a documentary about Bob Lazar, the man at the center of a well-known 1989 Las Vegas UFO story, was a recording called the teller tape, and it surfaced only because a woman named Vanessa found it. The researcher Luigi Vendittelli, who worked on the project, tells Michels: 'We wouldn't have found the teller tape if it wasn't for Vanessa.'
